classification.reason: The product FAQ directly explains how to invite a teammate with a chosen role (Settings > Members > Invite), fully answering this how-to question with no policy exception or refund involved.

draft.reply:
{"reply": "Hi there,

Adding your coworker as an Editor is quick to do:

1. Go to Settings > Members > Invite
2. Enter their email address
3. Choose the "Editor" role from the role options
4. Send the invite

They'll receive an email invitation to join your workspace. Just note that the invite link expires after 7 days, so ask them to accept it soon after you send it.

Let us know if you run into any issues!

Best,
Loopwise Support", "citations": ["product_faq.md#how-do-i-invite-a-teammate"]}
